monday.later: Optional Gym A when scheduled: split squat · leg extension · pull-up skill · row · back extension · bike

gymPlan.title: Gym A — Quads + Pull-Up Skill + Back Extension

steps.title: Bike + ramp warm-up
steps.details: 4 min easy bike, then gradual low-load practice sets for split squat and knee extension. No exhausting warm-up.

steps.title: Supported Short-Stance Split Squat
steps.details: 3 × 8–12 PER LEG · start left, match right · 2–3 RIR · short stance, mostly upright torso, front knee travels forward comfortably, 2–3 s lowering · ~90–120 s between left+right pairs · gradual load/ROM progression.

steps.title: Leg Extension
steps.details: 3 × 10–15 · 1–2 RIR · slow 2–3 sec eccentric and controlled knee extension · ~90 s rest. Progress clean reps then weight; do not judge by next-day soreness.

steps.title: Negative Pull-Ups
steps.details: 3 × 3–5 controlled 4–6-sec lowers (or 3–6 assisted FULL reps if possible) · 2–3 reps in reserve in assisted sets · avoid shoulder discomfort; track total quality reps.

steps.title: Chest-Supported Row
steps.details: 2 × 8–12 · 2–3 RIR · maintain scapular pulling strength, not maximal back hypertrophy.

steps.title: 45° Back Extension
steps.details: 2 × 10–15 · controlled 2-sec lower; hip-hinge with comfortable lumbar posture, avoid loaded hyperextension or radiating symptoms.

steps.title: Zone 2 cardio bike
steps.details: 15 min steady moderate bike, conversational breathing. If legs very fatigued, reduce intensity rather than grinding.

steps.title: Equipment transitions
steps.details: Set up machines and drink water.

thursday.later: Optional Gym B when scheduled: pull-ups · leg press · split squat · leg extension · ham curl · TRX face pull · stairs

gymPlan.title: Gym B — Quads + Pull-Ups + TRX Face Pull

steps.title: Bike + leg-press ramp sets
steps.details: 4 min easy bike plus two smooth leg-press ramp sets; keep knees comfortable.

steps.title: Pull-Ups / Assisted Pull-Ups
steps.details: 4 × 4–8 clean reps · 2–3 RIR · consistent full controlled range and ~2 min rest; track total clean reps and assistance used. Goal: more unassisted reps, not maximum back size.

steps.title: Leg Press
steps.details: 2 × 10–12 · 2–3 RIR · slightly lower foot placement only if heels stay planted, pelvis stable, knees/hips pain-free. Use knee-friendly depth; can substitute heel-elevated Smith squat.

steps.title: Supported Short-Stance Split Squat
steps.details: 2 × 8–12 PER LEG · 2–3 RIR · control front-knee travel and mostly upright torso; 90–120 s between pairs; start weaker side.

steps.title: Leg Extension
steps.details: 3 × 12–15 · 1–2 RIR · 2–3 sec lower · ~90 s rest. Directly prioritize quads.

steps.title: Seated Hamstring Curl
steps.details: 2 × 10–15 · 2–3 RIR · controlled pain-free range, no abrupt increase when hamstrings sore. Maintenance, not quad work.

steps.title: TRX Face Pull
steps.details: 3 × 10–15 with suspension straps (TRX), pull hands toward face and rotate outward only as pain-free; 1–2 RIR, progress by changing body angle. Keep neck long, ribs controlled, allow shoulder blades to move naturally.

steps.title: StairMaster cardio
steps.details: 10 min easy/moderate continuous stair climbing; if heavy quad fatigue or knee discomfort, substitute low-resistance bike.

steps.title: Equipment transitions
steps.details: Change machines and rest before harder sets.
